purpose: Read-only review of externally installed proof-bound implementation failure routing

validator_diff.basis: Current authoritative validator b1241921 versus current installed validator 318d0b09. Includes the previously known registered_blocked_tests live-only addition, plus new execution_failure and blocked-PM defect routing guards.

observed_behavior.predicate: Developer fail with defects, null implementation identities, and a same-invocation completed repository.test receipt with an integer nonzero exit and a test_log URI/hash named by the original result.
observed_behavior.validator: execution_failure is computed by the server from failure_proof; only Developer fail is excepted. A Developer pass remains invalid, and all other structural, packet, actor, test/evidence checks still run.
observed_behavior.publication: Original raw/canonical fail is retained. result_event emits run.blocked; Developer qa_verdict remains null. Later native publication and lifecycle handoff are distinct operations.
observed_behavior.diagnostic: record_failure appends at most one immutable implementation_failure_diagnostic audit using the verified receipt facts.
observed_behavior.helper_not_sufficient_alone: failure_proof binds call receipts by invocation; it does not independently call _owned or compare a receipt packet/run/fence. record_failure also has no ownership check. Surrounding original receipt, contract and publication/ownership checks remain required.
observed_behavior.remaining_early_success_defect: Installed complete_original still calls adapter.record before failure proof and strict result validation.

decision: Preserve this independently deployed workflow. Do not apply the older f951-based candidate or overwrite the current result_event/validator/helper. Await Root source reconciliation review.
